title: Keep Chat context setting consistent across screens
goal: Fix the mismatch where Settings can save a context length that Chat does not use, and align both screens on the same supported context window values.
context: Chat's contextual input builder reads the cached KernelSession chatContextTurnLimit, while Settings directly mutates the same UserDefaults key with a 1...128 Stepper. Values outside Chat's supported [4, 8, 12, 24, 48] options are silently ignored by Chat, and Settings changes can leave the session cache stale.
forbidden_changes: Do not change provider routing, model loading, memory retrieval, or privacy persistence behavior.
Do not change unrelated UI or runtime modules.
acceptance_criteria: Settings offers the same context-turn values as Chat: 4, 8, 12, 24, 48.
Settings changes synchronize into KernelSession and persist for the next request.
Contextual input reads the persisted value at request time rather than relying on stale cached state.
Changing context preference does not require restarting the app.
verification: Review final PR checks and changed-file scope
recovery: Revert the single task commit if Settings and Chat context controls diverge or the app build fails.
